title: Artifact Protocol
description: Shared artifact schema for TaskingAI plugin, backend, and frontend. This is the single source of truth for artifact type definitions, field constraints, and validation rules.

ArtifactType.description: The type of the artifact. Only these 5 types are supported across all layers.

Artifact.description: Standard artifact data transfer object (DTO). All layers must use this exact schema.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the artifact. Must be in 'type/subtype' format, lowercase.

title.description: The display title of the artifact. Will be truncated if exceeds max length.

content.description: The text content of the artifact (for text, json, table, etc.). Will be truncated if exceeds max content length.

preview_url.description: The preview image URL of the artifact.

download_url.description: The download URL of the artifact.

size.description: The size of the artifact in bytes.

ArtifactList.description: List of artifacts. Maximum 10 artifacts per tool output.

MAX_ARTIFACT_CONTENT_LENGTH.description: Maximum length for artifact content in characters. Content exceeding this will be truncated.

MAX_ARTIFACT_TITLE_LENGTH.description: Maximum length for artifact title in characters. Title exceeding this will be truncated.

MAX_ARTIFACTS_PER_TOOL.description: Maximum number of artifacts per tool output. Extra artifacts will be dropped.

defaultMimeTypes.description: Default MIME types for each artifact type when not explicitly provided.

mimeTypeMap.description: Mapping from file extension to MIME type for URL-based MIME type guessing.
